summary.text: H. Scott Landry Jr. is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 75 in the November 3, 2026 general election and previously served in the Maine House from 2018 to 2024.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as farmer.

paragraphs.text: Landry earned a B.S. from the University of Maine at Farmington in 1970, and his career experience includes working as a farmer.
He has served on the boards of directors of the Healthy Community Coalition, the High Peaks Alliance, and Life Enrichment Advancing People (LEAP).
Ballotpedia lists Landry as a member of the Maine House of Representatives from 2018 to 2024, representing District 75 from December 6, 2022, to December 3, 2024.
Its campaign finance summary records general-election wins in 2020, for District 113, and in 2022, for District 75.
In the 2023-2024 term he chaired the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee and also served on the Marine Resources Committee.
Landry is listed among candidates who withdrew from the 2024 general election for District 75.
Landry advanced from the Democratic primary for District 75 on June 9, 2026, receiving 905 votes in the first round, and faces Republican Randall Gauvin in the general election.
